name: Fukou na Kaa-san to Shiawase Love Love Seikatsu
original_name: 不幸な母さんとしあわせラブラブ生活
source:
My father... "That man", committed domestic violence.

I lived by myself for a few years while becoming a college student, and I chose to take in my mother.

"That man" had found another woman and had thrown her away.

When my mother arrived, her body and heart were both exhausted, she couldn't sleep at night, and couldn't hold a proper conversation in her depressed state

Living together, her heart started opening up bit by bit, but my mother having suffered "That man"'s abuse, had changed.

Even though she was so cheerful and bright. She started to pander to me while being scared.

Not wanting to be thrown away by me, she starting to cook, clean, and wash my back in the bathroom.

The acts escalated, and to relieve my sexual urges, she even said she will give me fellatio.

If I refuse her, her heart might close again.

And also.... my mother is too attractive... I might lose to the temptation.

I want my mother to return to her kind and cheerful self.

I want to become happy together.
What should I do?

translation:
我的父亲……“那个男人”，犯下了家庭暴力。

当我成为一名大学生时，我独自生活了几年，我选择收养我的母亲。

“那个男人”又找到了另一个女人，却把她抛弃了。

妈妈来的时候，身心俱疲，晚上睡不着觉，心情郁闷，无法正常交谈。

生活在一起，她的心一点一点地开放，但母亲在遭受了“那个男人”的虐待后，已经发生了改变。

尽管她是那么的开朗、开朗。她一边害怕一边开始迎合我。

她不想被我扔掉，开始给我做饭、打扫卫生、到浴室给我洗背。

行为升级了，为了缓解我的性冲动，她甚至说要给我口交。

如果我拒绝她，她的心可能会再次关闭。

还有……我妈妈太有魅力了……我可能会败给诱惑。

我希望妈妈能回到她善良开朗的样子。

我想一起变得幸福。
我应该怎么办？
